from dwave.system.composites import QUBOEmbeddingComposite
import numpy as np

def format_qubo(qubo_linear, qubo_quadratic, qubo_objective, penalty_equality, penalty_conflict):
    qp = QuadraticProgram(qubo_linear, qubo_quadratic, objective=qubo_objective, senses="minimize")

    return qp
